statement: On a Nintendo TR HID Bluetooth device Linux v6.12 first requests status and conditionally initializes an attached ordinary extension, selects Gen 2 and builtin MP policy, and then a worker reinitializes A400 and A600, probes A600FA/6, re-reads normal A400FA/6, and maps MP as 04/05/07 when an MP sensor consumer opens. Report mode/status handling is state-dependent. This is a conditional source call graph, not an observed retail Plus packet trace.

applicability.revision: TR/Gen 2 pinned consumer paths; no retail or firmware revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Linux core v6.12 411-557,570-605,811-905,1100-1224,1414-1493; modules 2712-2782. All acceptance/physical experiments explicitly not run.
